## About
All About Roofing Repair & Installation is a family-owned and operated roofing company in San Jose. We work on residential and commercial roofs with our own in-house crews and no subcontractors, and we have offices in San Jose and Orange, CA.
We know what Bay Area weather does to a roof, from heavy winter rains to scorching summer heat. We serve neighborhoods from Willow Glen and Almaden Valley to Campbell, Los Gatos, and Sunnyvale, and we keep to transparent pricing and honest communication on every job.
One reviewer put it simply: the owners are wonderful people, and their sons, who are also involved in the business, are just as kind and hardworking. We're rated 4.9 from 59 Google reviews.

## Services
- Roof Repair: Shingle repairs, flashing problems and leaks, big or small. We patch leaks and shore up weak spots before small problems become costly ones.
- Roof Replacement: Composition shingle, tile and flat roof membrane replacements. We remove and haul off the old materials and check the subroofing before the new roof goes on.
- Roof Installation: New roofs for homes and businesses, with help choosing materials that last longer and can lower your utility costs.
- Emergency Roof Repair: Wind damage, a lightning strike or a tree limb through the roof. Our team evaluates the damage and makes the needed repairs before your home is further compromised.
- Commercial Roofing: Roofing for office buildings, warehouses and retail spaces, from repairs to full replacements.
- Gutter Installation: An add-on to our roof repair and replacement packages, so water drains off your roof the way it should.
- Attic Fans: An add-on to our roofing services that helps cool your attic and your home, with solar attic fans available too.
- Mold Removal and Remediation: Mold thrives where moisture sits. We remove it to help keep your household safe, in San Jose and Orange, CA.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We have offices in San Jose and Orange, CA. Around the Bay Area we serve Santa Clara County, Fremont, Palo Alto, Mountain View, Sunnyvale, Campbell, Los Gatos, Cupertino and nearby communities, plus Orange County.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Do you work on commercial roofs?
A: Yes. We handle both residential and commercial roofing.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call our office or request a free quote through the site, and we'll take it from there.
